title: MOJO - A Swingin' Christmas
seo_title: MOJO - A Swingin' Christmas in Springfield, MO
description: MOJO - A Swingin' Christmas is a Saturday night of holiday music by the Missouri Jazz Orchestra, with guest vocalists and audience sing-alongs, and possibly a visit from a red-suited cat. It takes place on November 28, 2026 (time TBD) at 325 Park Central E in Springfield, MO.
